 Archibald Nuit Blanche White IPA Recalled For Metal Pieces
 November 12, 2026 by Linda Larsen 
 Archibald Nuit Blanche White IPA is being recalled in Canada for foreign material contamination in the form of metal pieces. This poses a choking, tooth injury, mouth injury, and GI tract injury hazard. The recall notice did not state whether or not any injuries have been reported to the company to date in connection with the consumption of the product. The recalling firm is Archibald Inc.
 The product is a beer that is packaged in 473 milliliter cans. Each package contains four cans. The UPC number that is stamped on the product label is 8 76976 00078 4. All cans with codes that start with J28Q61 are included in this recall. Also recalled is the same product, sold as individual cans. The UPC number for that item is 8 76976 00075 3. All codes starting with J28Q61 are included in the recall.
 The beer was sold at the retail level in the province of Quebec. No pictures of the recalled products were included in the recall notice.
 If you purchased this beer, do not drink it. You can throw it away in a secure trash can with a tight fitting lid after first double wrapping or bagging it so other people can’t see it, or you can take it back to the store where you bought it for a full refund.
